summary.text: Shanel Thomas-Henry represents the 21st District on the New York City Council, which includes Corona, East Elmhurst, Lefrak and Jackson Heights in Queens.
Her Council biography says she is a lifelong Corona and East Elmhurst resident and chairs the Committee on Small Business.

paragraphs.text: Thomas-Henry grew up in a family rooted in service and small business, with family businesses along Northern Boulevard, according to her Council biography.
She graduated from Howard University with degrees in international business and public administration.
Before joining the Council she was Community Outreach Manager for the $8 billion LaGuardia Redevelopment Program, helping to launch workforce pipelines, scholarships and STEM programming.
She has served on the New York City Industrial Development Agency, Elmcor, Neighborhood Housing Services of Queens CDC, the 115th Precinct Council and Community Board 3.
She lives in the district with her husband and four children.
